song.name: The Sentinel's Gambit
song.plot: Vorgos, Sentinel of the Aether, has watched the tilt and the war. Now he must act: pluck a mortal from Auroria and throw her into the war-torn Underworld as a cosmic stop-gap. He does it because the balance demands it — pragmatic, not benevolent — and it costs him his role as passive observer and the harm to one life. The decision to tear the Great Rift.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: Vorgos, first person — the agonized decision. Anchors: the Aether, the Stormbringer, the balance, the Great Rift (the coming act he will tear open), Auroria, the Underworld, "a scholar" / "a life" (Anya's life, unnamed), the cosmic stop-gap. No suggestion Anya is a soldier or warrior (she is a scholar); no hint this is fair or kind. Structure: Verse 1 → Pre-Chorus → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus. Grave, swelling. Suggested Suno direction: tragic, monumental — heavy orchestra, storm, a lone voice over the storm, swelling to the decision.

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: I have watched the threefold scale descend, And done nothing but observe the fall. But now the balance asks me for a life, And I must answer, though it burns it all.

section.name: Pre-Chorus
section.reworked: A scholar in the Sanctum of the light, A single soul to staunch the endless night.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The Sentinel's gambit — I tear the sky, The Great Rift opens, the scholar falls. I am the Stormbringer who makes it die, To buy the planes their final walls.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: I do not call it mercy, not a grace, I call it what it is — a needed crime. To throw one life into the Underworld's face, And hold the darkness back a little time.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The Sentinel's gambit — I tear the sky, The Great Rift opens, the scholar falls. I am the Stormbringer who makes it die, To buy the planes their final walls.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: I was the watcher; now I am the blade, And what I cut can never be unmade. Forgive me not — I ask no world's release, Only the balance's impossible peace.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The Sentinel's gambit — I tear the sky, The Great Rift opens, the scholar falls. I am the Stormbringer who makes it die, To buy the planes their final walls.
